runtime: Kotlin / Jetpack Compose; no Ionic or Cordova runtime

environment.device: owned Pixel 8 API 36 Google APIs emulator

safety.product_push: intercepted by TestTodayWeatherApp; no token argument
safety.alarms: edited then discarded; stored push state asserted unchanged
safety.share: Android text chooser opened and canceled; no recipient
safety.data: live weather/geocode/nation/Places reads; seeded saved places for later sections
safety.sdk_network: Google Places, test ads, consent, Firebase installation/configuration/messaging may contact their services
safety.cleanup: both task APKs removed on exit; runner fails offline if removal cannot be verified

processing: RGB, Lanczos 1080x2400 -> 720x1600, 256-color MEDIANCUT without dithering; no screen content replaced or redrawn
limitations: API36 emulator captures; not a release APK or physical-device certification
Live values, test advertisements, forecasts, available warning bulletins and Android dialogs vary
No actual notification delivery, analytics opt-in, or share recipient exercised
The selected photo and SDK artwork retain their original third-party rights
